method: Hash-verify archived plans, graph, coverage, manifests, receipts and predictions. Join exact original graph node IDs to added CONTROL_DEPENDENCE sources/targets. Compare fixed best and auxiliary last independently.
limitations: Endpoint overlap is association, not proof that a new edge caused that node prediction.
Messages can propagate beyond direct endpoints; relation parameters and optimization changes can affect other nodes and files.
Counts are HCG-node CV validation, not unique source-line F1 or independent test.
Same filename is disambiguated by cohort and source SHA; no label reassessment was performed.
Few changed nodes and a single fixed seed do not establish semantic causality or generalization.
